row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Blackbaud's SSO documentation offers SAML 2.0 and OIDC sign-in through Blackbaud ID with just-in-time provisioning where 'users can be provisioned but are not assigned permissions or access to solutions'; no SCIM endpoint is documented and all pricing is a personalized quote.
row.notes: Status changed from partial (June) to none (by absence). June noted SCIM was 'not confirmed on public materials'; the September check of Blackbaud's SSO documentation, the SKY API directory and the pricing page found no SCIM endpoint. Blackbaud ID SSO (SAML 2.0 or OIDC) can JIT-create Blackbaud IDs, but users get no permissions or solution access until an admin invites them, and disabling a user in the IdP does not by itself block a Blackbaud ID that signs in another way. Researched as the Raiser's Edge NXT / Blackbaud ID admin layer; the SKY API has user endpoints only for Education Management (School and Education Core APIs), not for Raiser's Edge NXT or Financial Edge NXT users. All pricing is quote-based, so no team, SSO or SCIM price can be recorded. The SSO docs site is a JavaScript app; quotes are cited from its page bundle with page_url pointing to the human page. Okta's catalogue Blackbaud app is password vaulting (SWA) only.

plans.name: Raiser's Edge NXT and other Blackbaud solutions (quote-based)
plans.price_text: Personalized quote; no public price list
plans.notes: No public tiers. SSO is configured at the Blackbaud ID organization level across solutions; no plan gate published.

scim.notes: No SCIM in the SSO docs bundle (all routes) or the SKY API directory.

limitations.text: The SKY API directory lists constituent, gift, fundraising, finance and education APIs; only the Education Management APIs (Education Core, School) expose user information; no Raiser's Edge NXT staff-user management API is listed.

okta.notes: Okta catalogue shows SWA only (last updated Aug. 8 2022); Blackbaud documents generic SAML 2.0/OIDC SSO instead.

fallbacks.notes: JIT creates Blackbaud IDs only; solution access still needs an admin invite.
